svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leaves: two 120 x 110 cut from 0.5 hardened spring steel shim;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cut with snips or a guillotine, no bends or kinks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamps: four blocks 30 x 140 x 20; slit each along its middle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the leaf is gripped between two halves; two M5 screws each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower clamps screw to the base plate, upper to the carriage,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 200 apart, so the leaves stand parallel and 80 free between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Assemble with a 80 spacer block between the clamps to set height

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: carriage moves freely fore and aft, springs back to zero
